summary: Backend-only validation of deploy/* IP-mode changes (Caddy IP cert, change-domain.sh IP/domain branches, docker-compose web ports/env, backend notification_config/whatsapp.py config checks, bash -n). All five requested checks pass. One minor issue found in change-domain.sh domain-mode exit code when hostname is unresolvable.

minor.issue: Domain-mode with an UNRESOLVABLE hostname exits 2 (getent returns 2, trips `set -e` before the DNS-check branch prints its message) instead of the designed exit 1 with the PERINGATAN message. .env is left unchanged either way. For a resolvable but mismatched domain (e.g. google.com) exit is correctly 1 with the Indonesian warning. Fix suggestion: `got="$(getent ahostsv4 "$host" | awk 'NR==1{print $1}' || true)"` so getent's rc=2 does not short-circuit the loop.

action_items: Optional: make change-domain.sh tolerate getent returning rc=2 so an unresolvable hostname still exits 1 with the Indonesian 'PERINGATAN' message (currently exits 2 with no message). Non-blocking: .env is still untouched and the operator still sees a failure.
critical_code_review_comments: Caddyfile uses global `default_sni {$SERVER_IP}` + acme profile shortlived + tls-alpn disabled; adapts cleanly in both IP mode (listens :443, :5678, :3000, host matcher IP_SERVER) and domain mode (single :443 server with per-host subroutes). /api/* -> backend:8001 preserved.

docker-compose.yml valid; web publishes 80, 443, 443/udp, 5678, 3000. backend CORS_ORIGINS and APP_URL both = https://${APP_DOMAIN}; web build arg REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL = https://${APP_DOMAIN}; n8n WEBHOOK_URL = https://${N8N_DOMAIN}/ and N8N_HOST correctly removed.
setup.sh writes APP_DOMAIN=${IP}, N8N_DOMAIN=${IP}:5678, WAHA_DOMAIN=${IP}:3000 and `ufw allow 5678/tcp` + `ufw allow 3000/tcp`. bash -n passes on both scripts.

change-domain.sh IP mode: writes APP_DOMAIN=IP, N8N_DOMAIN=IP:5678, WAHA_DOMAIN=IP:3000, rewrites N8N_*_WEBHOOK_URL host while preserving path (/webhook/crm-whatsapp) and leaving the webhook secret untouched; creates .env.bak.<timestamp>; calls `ufw allow 5678/tcp` and `ufw allow 3000/tcp`; updates SERVER_IP when it changes.
notification_config.https_url() and whatsapp.whatsapp_configuration_error() accept https://IP_SERVER and https://IP_SERVER:5678/webhook/crm-whatsapp (returns '' = OK, whatsapp_configured() True).
mailer._assert_safe_email() correctly rejects numeric-host https links in email bodies (G3 anti-phishing rule, unchanged, intentional - not a bug).
